verdict.rationale: Docs confirm serving-stack support for this part: vLLM 'Full support', llama.cpp 'Supported for efficient inference', SGLang mentioned, and ROCm/PyTorch/TensorFlow/JAX/ONNX compatibility explicitly listing gfx1201 (RX 9070 XT). However, there is no documentation of FP8/FP4 low-precision inference formats for this GPU, and TensorRT-LLM is absent (expected, as it's an NVIDIA-specific stack) leaving the precision-format half of the story unaddressed. Missing for 10: explicit FP8/FP4 quantization support documentation for RX 9070 XT, and any TensorRT-LLM-equivalent cross-stack corroboration.
